description: This file defines the ProductAttributeController class, which handles HTTP requests related to product attribute management in the admin section of a sales management web application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, editing, saving, deleting, and querying product attributes and options, interacting with service layers and rendering UI views.

classes.name: ProductAttributeController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling admin operations for product attributes, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting attributes.

methods.name: displayProductAttributes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list product attributes for a specific product, verifying store ownership and returning the view.

methods.name: pageAttributes
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return a paginated list of product attributes in JSON format for AJAX.

methods.name: displayAttributeEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the attribute editing form for a specific product attribute.

methods.name: displayAttributeCreate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the attribute creation form for a product.

methods.name: displayAttribute
methods.description: Shared private method to prepare and display the form for creating or editing a product attribute.

methods.name: saveAttribute
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product attribute, including validation and processing of attribute options.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific product attribute, verifying ownership and returning JSON response.

methods.name: checkAttributeType
methods.description: Handles POST requests to query the type of a product option, returning type data in JSON.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up menu attributes for page views.
